Aegislash

Steel Ghost

Kalos · Generation 6

Aegislash is a Steel/Ghost-type Royal Sword Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 53 kg. It evolves from Doublade. Its highest base stat is Defense (140), with a base stat total of 500.
